value.Name: Fraternity and Sorority Life
value.Description:
Drexel University fraternities and sororities pride themselves on excellence and high standards. They embody the shared values of leadership, service, scholarship, and lifelong friendships. These chapters of inter/national organizations provide a positive impact to the larger Drexel community.

Key Highlights: 

1. 30+ Chapters: Social, culturally-based and religiously-based

2. 1200+ Undergraduate Members

3. 3.27 Cumulative Average GPA

4. 15+ Unique philanthropic causes supported

5. 400+ events held annually

 

Wondering if fraternity & sorority life is right for you? Fill out our interest form to receive more information!
value.Summary: Fraternities and sororities have been an integral part of the Drexel community since 1900. Our organizations pride themselves on excellence and dedication to leadership, service, scholarship, and lifelong friendships and connections to Drexel.

value.Name: Center for Learning and Academic Success Services
value.Description:
The Center for Learning and Academic Success Services (CLASS) empowers students to develop skills and strategies that foster academic success and personal growth through purposeful interactions with peer and professional staff.

CLASS supports Drexel University students' efforts to achieve their academic goals through a variety of services, including:

  • Academic Coaching
  • Tutoring
  • GSTD 100: Strategies for Academic Success
  • Workshops and Events

 

CLASS is a member of the Drexel University Learning Alliance.
value.Summary: CLASS provides academic support to Drexel University students, including academic skills workshops and peer and professional academic coaching.

value.Name: The American Optometric Student Association at Drexel
value.Description: AOSA at Drexel is the Pennsylvania College of Optometry’s chapter of the American Optometric Student Association, the national organization for optometry students. It’s student-led and dedicated to advocating for the profession, enhancing optometry education, and empowering students to succeed as future doctors of optometry. Through events like quiz bowls, fundraisers, info nights, and national meetings, AOSA helps build community, leadership skills, and professional development among students at Drexel.
value.Summary: AOSA at Drexel is a student-led organization that supports optometry students through advocacy, professional development, and community engagement, helping prepare future doctors of optometry for success.

value.Name: Theme Park Engineering and Design Group
value.Description:
The Drexel Theme Park Engineering and Design Group (Drexel TPED) is an officially recognized organization of the Themed Entertainment Association (TEA) that provides Drexel undergraduate students and the surrounding Philadelphia community with resources and knowledge pertaining to the themed entertainment industry!

 

In TPED you can learn about the behind-the-scenes work that goes into your favorite theme park attractions, discuss live entertainment like concerts or escape rooms, and even go on trips to some of your favorite themed experiences!

 

We achieve our mission by (1) learning about the various facets of themed entertainment at general body meetings; (2) facilitating hands-on learning, leadership, and interdisciplinary collaboration through industry-related projects; (3) volunteering our services at local Philly schools and Drexel events; and (4) providing opportunities for networking and for gaining industry-relevant experiences through competitions, conferences, guest speakers, behind-the-scenes tours, and trips to themed venues!

 

The themed entertainment industry encompasses all disciplines, which our activities reflect. All majors are welcomed and encouraged to attend our events!

 

For more information and to get involved in TPED, please join our Discord!
value.Summary: The Drexel Theme Park Engineering and Design Group (Drexel TPED) is an undergraduate organization at Drexel University that celebrates the themed entertainment industry! For more information, please visit our website: www.drexeltped.org
